sources.title: Berezin transform on compact Hermitian symmetric spaces
sources.full_text_provenance: Author-uploaded full text of the primary article; publisher page metadata and abstract separately checked.
used_results: Sections 1.1-1.2: coherent resolution, Wick/covariant-symbol maps, Berezin transform, and line-bundle coherent states
Theorem 3.6: Berezin transform eigenvalue via Gindikin gamma function
Theorem 4.2: multiplicity-free tensor/coherent-symbol support with component weights bounded by line-bundle level
sources.specialization: Type-I Grassmannian Gr(r,d), a=2, b=d-2r, p=d, n=r(d-r); reversing the source weight tuple yields the partition product in GRASSMANN_CARTAN_ROUNDING.txt.

limits: The paper supplies the Berezin spectrum and representation support. The Petz transfer identity, compatible broadcast construction, and scalar deficit comparison are derived in the worker artifact; external priority for that combined comparison is not established.
